t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The participant split the 2 types of gnomes into a color pattern. Earthy ones and Color ones, like a team, rather. They can switch up the point system half way through the line so you have to pay attention.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are split into 2 groups. Find which color way works best for you. Green, purple, blue, red was my go to. The rest rewarded less points, always. I wish you the best!
